entity.summary: Centralized cryptocurrency exchange operated under the GRAVIO/GRAVIEX identity from 2017 until its announced shutdown on 2024-10-20.
entity.notes: The operator's original ANN says GRAVIEX was first released in 2017 for GIO trading and later expanded. HEI normalizes that year-level statement to 2017-01-01 rather than inventing a more precise first-release date. The terminal marker is 2024-10-20 because the official @graviex_net shutdown post set that date and contemporaneous independent references repeated the same deadline. Post-closure complaints are not used to classify Graviex as a scam or hack. Jurisdiction is left Unknown because available sources conflict between Russia and Malta and this review does not establish a sufficiently reliable legal/operating origin claim.

events.title: Graviex first released for GIO trading
events.description: The GRAVIO team stated that GRAVIEX was first released in 2017 to enable GIO trading before later expansion.
events.notes: Year-level normalization only; no exact 2017 launch day is claimed.

events.title: Graviex announced October 20 shutdown
events.description: The official Graviex X account published a shutdown notice setting 2024-10-20 as the end of operations.
events.notes: The X post date is derived from the official post identifier timestamp. Contemporary project coverage linked the same official post and instructed users to withdraw before October 20.

events.title: Graviex reached its announced shutdown date
events.description: Graviex ceased exchange operations on its announced 2024-10-20 terminal date.
events.notes: Later tracker evidence shows no active markets and treats the venue as ceased/discontinued.

evidence.title: GRAVIEX Exchange operator announcement thread
evidence.notes: Operator-authored ANN states that GRAVIEX was first released in 2017 for GIO trading and identifies the GRAVIO Team as core development and management.

evidence.title: Graviex shutdown notice
evidence.notes: Official Graviex account post. The current fetch does not render the post text, so the shutdown wording and October 20 deadline are cross-checked against contemporaneous sources that directly link this exact post.

evidence.title: SpaceXpanse progress report referencing Graviex shutdown
evidence.notes: Contemporaneous project report directly links the official Graviex X notice and states that the exchange would cease operations on October 20, urging users to withdraw beforehand.

evidence.title: BitcoinTalk post-closure discussion referencing official Graviex notice
evidence.notes: Post-closure discussion says Graviex had announced via its pinned X post that operations would cease on October 20 and links the exact official post. Used only to corroborate the terminal date.

evidence.title: Graviex exchange profile
evidence.notes: Current tracker shows zero active markets and states that Graviex ceased operations on 2024-10-20.
